message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to VirusTotal’s API or the ability to query DNS records. If you have a script or tool that can make HTTP requests, you could also query VirusTotal’s “Domain Details” endpoint with your key (`ig_key001`) to see the available record types.
